description:
Goal
One source callable construction owns one runtime callable object and one producer-correlated member dispatch plan. Exact calls may use a private executable ABI. Every indirect CallClosure consumes only the runtime value's public callable ABI. Root backend packaging closes every physical ABI contract; Native and the backend interpreter do not reconstruct it from transport positions or World.

First losses
1. Root packaging flattened producer member relations and reused position-level identity at consumers. A shared generic consumer can receive several constructions, so no consumer position can select one entry.
2. Symbolic transport records were reused after root packaging. CallReturnFlow, BackendEntryOrigin, semantic inputs, entry captures, and construction captures retained positions or omitted TransportCarrier; consumers reopened MaterializedTransportPlan to finish the contract.
3. BackendConstructionWrapper.return_layout mixed the first private member's ShapeId/divergence with a public one-lane ValueRef ABI.
4. Runtime dispatch reachability treated free inference templates as concrete runtime subjects, pruning valid numeric dispatch.

Proven model
- CallableFlowFact is the semantic authority for one producer: function, lexical captures, member resolutions, and semantic input mappings.
- TransportLayout is the one component-solved structural shape plus carrier verdict. Publication positions anchor ValueRef; private structural values remain carrier-absent.
- One BackendValueLayout { structural, carrier, tys, reprs } is the packaged physical value contract. Semantic inputs and entry captures embed it. BackendReturnLayout adds only divergence.
- Symbolic positions end at RootBackendProduct packaging. Packaged return flow is Tail, Continue { source contract }, or Deliver { source contract, entry }. The owning executable/entry already owns the sink contract.
- ReturnPayload/ResumePayload are transport-analysis continuation seams. They constrain tail classification, then disappear. They are not executable intermediate transformations.
- A public construction return is a closed physical form: Diverges when every member diverges; Absent when every nondivergent member is zero-width; ValueRef when every nondivergent member produces a value. Mixed absent/value members are invalid. No private member ShapeId or Ty crosses this boundary.
- Construction identity is consumed only by FunctionRef/Lambda allocation. The runtime FnId/code pointer is the sole indirect-call identity. Exact target selection remains call-edge-owned.
- A type inference template is not a runtime subject domain. Runtime reachability recursively grounds free variables to Any while preserving known surrounding structure, then refines that envelope through dispatch.

Spike proofs
- Full-library temporary instrumentation observed zero ClosureCall tails carrying construction and zero interpreter construction fallback hits. Removing only the fallback preserves Enum/Range interpreter and JIT controls. Delete the tail field/fallback; retain allocation-step construction.
- Focused Range/Enum/multi_relay inventories found zero nondivergent source/payload/caller triples with differing layouts. The sole differing Range2 route diverges through Enum.EmptyError and never invokes a continuation. This falsifies the earlier staged-accumulator hypothesis.
- `ea1920945` is a green WIP for sealed return routes: 263 additions, 286 deletions; strict clippy and Enum/Range/multi_relay gates pass. It adds carrier to the endpoint contract, splits symbolic/packaged entry origins, deletes packaged endpoint catalogs and Native scans, and uses contract codecs.
- `568c80c30` is a green WIP for BackendCallableReturn: net zero lines; strict clippy and wrapper/Enum/Range gates pass. Full-library inventory found multi-member private returns uniform; the wrapper no longer copies member semantic shape/type.
- `4bc36c472` is a green WIP for shared BackendValueLayout: 376 additions, 462 deletions; strict clippy and Enum/Range/construction gates pass. Native/interpreter input scans and interpreter input cache are deleted; entry captures and construction captures are closed; BackendCallArg.position and position_publishes_callable are deleted.
- `a95594f54` preserves the larger coherent WIP and its previously-green behavior, but failed fresh audit on the three issues above and is not itself a landing candidate.

Other prerequisites already proven in a95594f54
- Producer constructions retain all specialized members and one selection plan.
- Public carrier anchoring, carrier-backed tuple construction, exact target input semantic-index projection, original resume-entry identity mapping, divergence-aware return flow, zero-width shape consumption, and executable input tys/reprs are required together.
- Entry dispatch is callee-owned; exporting clause outcomes to callers caused duplicate activations and schedule-dependent frontiers. Removing that leak makes quicksort stable at 17.
- Transport freshness validation belongs before memo return. Producer-level validation below the cache was unreachable when every member was memoized.
- Runtime-envelope grounding legitimately widens fixture 00420 five times; RETURN_WIDENING_BUDGET 10 is the measured 2x guard.

Landing strategy
Start from fz-1ah/integration HEAD. Apply the coherent a95594f54 changes and the three green spike models into one uncommitted implementation tree, reconcile overlaps around the shared BackendValueLayout, and make one final fz-k22.23 commit. Prefer the shared contract and deletions over parallel route/input/capture codecs. Remove, do not retain:
- BackendTail::ClosureCall.construction and interpreter fallback
- payload/caller positions from packaged return flow
- packaged BackendExecutable.return_endpoints and Native endpoint scans
- duplicated structural/carrier/tys/reprs records
- Native/interpreter executable-input binding scans/cache
- packaged entry/capture/construction source positions with no consumer
- BackendCallArg.position
- position_publishes_callable and publication-count fallbacks
- first-member public return layout selection
- NativeBody callable-value boundary side tables and call-time identity recovery
- duplicate position_shapes/transport_shapes storage and superseded helpers

Tests must assert intent through production artifacts, not counts or mechanics. Add no code comments; put discoveries here.

Acceptance
- Model tests prove one producer construction with every member, allocation-only identity, closed shared value layouts, no packaged symbolic positions, and public return closed form.
- Enum operator-ref, take/drop/split, predicate search, Range scalar/2/3, multi_relay, opaque joins, resource destructor, direct-only no-allocation, and quicksort interp/JIT/build controls pass.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass, except the three baseline raw-telemetry handler tests below until fz-1ah.12 lands.
- Release fz2 build of fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz emits no diagnostics and remains about 0.05-0.06s with or without telemetry. Telemetry remains 1,114 JSONL records rather than the original approximately 3,200.

Known baseline outside this ticket
At pristine integration ca59b76ac, exactly three library tests already fail because handlers still expect copied telemetry metadata: compiler2_notes_top_level_types_into_the_global_scope, compiler2_protocol_domain_marker_stays_type_owned_while_dispatch_revises_when_impls_land, and source_publication_defers_local_macro_expansion_until_function_demand. fz-1ah.12 owns them. Do not restore emitter-side copies.
title: fz-k22: preserve producer callable constructions behind one public indirect ABI
